fact: Loi n°025/2023 of 12 July 2023, amending the 2011 data protection law Loi n°001/2011 with a full regime (rights, controller duties, DPOs, breach notification, sanctions), was promulgated by Decret n°166/PR and published in the Journal Officiel n°218 Bis of 15 July 2023, with no compliance grace period (art. 219).

Article 7 of Loi n°025/2023 creates the Autorité pour la Protection des Données Personnelles et de la Vie Privée (APDPVP) as an independent administrative authority, with powers to authorise processing, receive complaints, and issue warnings, formal notices, suspensions and fines of CFA 1 million to 100 million (arts. 199-204); the text names no appointment of its members.

Ordonnance n°00002/PR/2020 of 31 January 2020, published in the Journal Officiel n°60 Bis of 27 March 2020, amends and completes the 2011 data protection law Loi n°001/2011 (adding rights to portability and erasure, a data protection delegate, and fines of CFA 1 million to 100 million); it was later superseded by Loi n°025/2023.

The ordonnance sets the organs of the Commission Nationale pour la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (bureau, plenary, restricted formation, provincial offices), creates its levy (RPPVP, CFA 1,000 per person a year) and its accounting agency; it names no appointment of members.
